title: Laguna Gov. Aragones faces fresh graft complaint over chemo center
summary: Laguna Governor Sol Aragones faced Tuesday a fresh graft complaint before the Office of the Ombudsman over the alleged operation of a chemotherapy center without license at the provincial hospital.
